name: deAction Surf Shop
summary: A wooden beach shop on Silver Sands, run by windsurfer Brian Talma, that teaches windsurfing, kitesurfing, surfing and stand up paddling. A sheltered lagoon suits first timers, and the outer reef has waves for experienced riders. The shop also rents and sells Naish boards, sails and kites.
standouts: Beachfront shop on deAction Beach, Silver Sands
Lagoon area for beginners and outer reef waves for experienced riders
Rents and sells Naish surf, SUP, kite and windsurf equipment
Kitesurfing lessons led by instructor Tony "Corn" Lord

contact.address: deAction Shop & Beach Appartments, Silver Sands, Christ Church, Barbados

trips.title: SUP Safari
trips.summary: A stand up paddle along the south coast from the deAction shop to Oistins, about two miles, passing many surf spots on the way. At Oistins the group snorkels with turtles.
highlights: About a two mile paddle from deAction Surf Shop to Oistins
Passes many surf spots on the south coast
trips.departsFrom: deAction Surf Shop, Silver Sands, Christ Church
trips.checkNotes: No price or duration on the site. 'Book Now' goes to the contact form. Turtle snorkel at Oistins is mentioned; no feeding is advertised.

trips.title: Beginner Stand Up Paddling Lesson
trips.summary: A first stand up paddle session that starts with a short briefing on the beach covering the basics and the route. Lessons run from Enterprise Beach, about ten minutes' drive from the shop.
highlights: Starts on Enterprise Beach, 10 minutes drive from the shop
5 minute briefing on the beach on the fundamentals of SUP and the route
trips.checkNotes: No price or lesson length on the site. Booking by the contact form or phone.

trips.title: Beginner Surf Lesson
trips.summary: A one hour first surf lesson: ten minutes on the beach learning how to stand up, then fifty minutes riding small waves. Lessons run in the inner waves by the shop or at Freights, a beginner spot five minutes' drive away.
highlights: 10 minute beach talk, then 50 minutes in the water
Inner small waves by the shop, or at Freights (5 minutes drive)
The shop states you will be standing up within the hour or your money back
trips.departsFrom: deAction Surf Shop, Silver Sands, or Freights
trips.checkNotes: No price on the site. Title is ours; the page describes 'the first hour long lesson'. Booking by the contact form or phone.

trips.title: "Riding" package
trips.summary: A two hour surf package that teaches you to pick a wave, catch it and ride it on your own.
highlights: Learn to select a wave, catch it and ride by yourself
trips.departsFrom: deAction Surf Shop, Silver Sands, or Freights
trips.checkNotes: No price on the site. Booking by the contact form or phone.

trips.title: "Surfer" package
trips.summary: A six hour surf package covering wave selection and catching waves, then moving on to more advanced moves such as turning on a wave.
highlights: Introduces more advanced moves such as turning on a wave
trips.departsFrom: deAction Surf Shop, Silver Sands, or Freights
trips.checkNotes: No price on the site, and it does not say how the six hours are split. Booking by the contact form or phone.

trips.title: Kitesurfing Starter package
trips.summary: A six hour kitesurfing course, usually split over two or three sessions. It moves from flying a small stunt kite to body dragging with a big kite and then getting up on the board. Lessons are run by a team led by Tony "Corn" Lord.
highlights: Six hours, normally divided into 2 to 3 sessions
Small stunt kite, then body dragging with a big kite, then getting up on the board
Flat water in the inner lagoon and waves off the outer reef
trips.departsFrom: deAction Surf Shop, Silver Sands, Christ Church
trips.checkNotes: No price on the site. Kite rentals need a confident level 3 rider (able to keep upwind). Booking by the contact form or phone.

trips.title: Beginner Windsurfing Lessons
trips.summary: Windsurfing lessons for beginners from the shop's instructors, starting in the lagoon for those not yet comfortable in waves. Intermediate and expert windsurfers can rent Naish freeride boards and sails.
highlights: Lagoon area for getting started away from the waves
Rental of Naish freeride boards and Naish sails from 4.5 to 7.0
trips.departsFrom: deAction Surf Shop, Silver Sands, Christ Church
trips.checkNotes: No price or lesson length on the site. Title is ours; the page says 'We offer lessons for beginners'. Booking by the contact form or phone.

checkNotes: Enquiry only: every 'Book Now' on the activity pages goes to the contact form at https://briantalma.pro/contact-us/. No prices anywhere on the site. Activity pages were last changed in July 2016 and the newest blog post is May 2018, though the home page was updated in April 2026, so the business looks to be in place but the lesson details may be out of date. The site also rents beach apartments, a studio and a house at Silver Sands and Long Beach (not included as trips). No email address or WhatsApp link on the site; the WooCommerce shop and BookSurfCamps camps mentioned in our list were not found on these pages.
